Package sc.fiji.snt.util

Enum Class Integration

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Integration>
sc.fiji.snt.util.Integration
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Integration>, java.lang.constant.Constable
public enum Integration extends Enum<Integration>
Optional software SNT can interact with, but does not depend on at compile time. Availability is determined at runtime by the presence of classes, which is more reliable than checking update-site subscriptions.
See Also:
